plan.summary: FEAT-TFM MVP: tenant-scoped semantic field-mapping resolver. Migration 028 (tenant_settings.field_mapping JSONB + leads.custom_1..custom_10 TEXT additive ALTER) + Shared DbTenantFieldMappingResolver with IMemoryCache (5min TTL) + TenantFieldMappingValidator (reserved-name + type + enum + source-range guards, INV-BE-096..099) + Backend GET/PUT /api/v1/tenant-settings/field-mapping (tenant-scoped JWT) + DI swap NullResolver→DbResolver in Backend/Outbound/Automation. UI editor, INMA mirror sync, flow builder semantic picker explicitly OUT OF SCOPE (later packets).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 028-tenant-field-mapping.sql idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS): tenant_settings.field_mapping JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb + leads.custom_1..custom_10 TEXT NULL kolonları + GRANT ALL ON tenant_settings, leads TO invekto. Canonical schema mirror tenant-settings.sql ve (varsa) leads.sql veya pkt6b1-niche-business.sql'e yansıtılır.

TenantFieldMappingEntry DTO (Shared/Contracts/TenantFieldMapping/Dtos/): { Source: string (cf1..cf10 enum guard), Type: string (enum/string/date/bool/int), EnumValues?: List<string>, Required?: bool }. JsonSerializerOptions snake_case (PropertyNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower).

TenantFieldMappingValidator (Shared/Services/): ValidateMapping(Dictionary<string, TenantFieldMappingEntry>) → throws TenantFieldMappingValidationException with INV-BE-096..099. RESERVED semantic names = InmaDynamicFieldKeys.Allowlist (15: name/email/note/pushname/datalistname + cf1..cf10) ∪ DB columns (id, tenant_id, full_name, phone, created_at, updated_at, pipeline_status, preferred_locale) → reject INV-BE-097. Reason: 'name' raw key INMA Allowlist'te zaten — tenant 'name' semantic'i kaydederse cf1'e map edip aynı zamanda raw 'name' Allowlist match alır → çakışma; reserved guard contract bug'ını önler. Source range cf1..cf10 enforce INV-BE-099. Type whitelist (enum/string/date/bool/int) INV-BE-096. Type=enum && enum_values null/empty reject INV-BE-098. Semantic name regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$ enforce INV-BE-096.

ErrorCodes.cs ekleme: INV-BE-096 (FieldMappingInvalid — type/regex), INV-BE-097 (FieldMappingReservedSemanticName), INV-BE-098 (FieldMappingEnumValueMissing), INV-BE-099 (FieldMappingSourceOutOfRange). arch/errors.md mirror.

DbTenantFieldMappingResolver (Shared/Contracts/TenantFieldMapping/) impl: ResolveToInmaKeyAsync(tenantId, placeholder, ct) → IMemoryCache hit (key 'tenant:field_mapping:{tenantId}', 5dk TTL, single-flight ConcurrentDictionary) → cache miss tenant_settings.field_mapping SELECT → JSONB deserialize → semantic→source lookup → 'cf1' style key döner; mapping yoksa veya placeholder mapping'de yoksa null (DMP raw key fallback davranışı korunur). PostgresConnectionFactory injected (Invekto.Shared.Data.PostgresConnectionFactory — mevcut pattern, 3 servisin de kullandığı). Typed catch (NpgsqlException, JsonException, OperationCanceledException) → fail-safe null return + JsonLinesLogger warn (resolver fail bug değil, DMP raw fallback'e düşer).

Backend/Data/TenantSettingsRepository.cs (yeni dosya) — Backend için tenant_settings repo. PostgresConnectionFactory injected. Methods: GetFieldMappingAsync(tenantId, ct) → JSON string + updated_at; UpsertFieldMappingAsync(tenantId, fieldMappingJson, ct) → INSERT ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET field_mapping=EXCLUDED.field_mapping, updated_at=NOW(). Outbound/Automation'daki Repository pattern'i ile uyumlu (per-service repo, microservice isolation).

Backend GET /api/v1/tenant-settings/field-mapping endpoint (tenant-scoped JWT — TenantContext.TenantId kullan, body'den tenant_id ALMA, JWT pattern'i Backend'in mevcut endpoint'leri ile aynı). Response: { tenant_id, field_mapping: { semantic_name: { source, type, enum_values, required } }, updated_at }. Mapping yoksa empty object. typed catch (NpgsqlException, JsonException, OperationCanceledException) + JsonLinesLogger.

Backend PUT /api/v1/tenant-settings/field-mapping endpoint (tenant-scoped JWT — TenantContext.TenantId kullan). Body: { tenant_id?: int, field_mapping: { semantic_name: TenantFieldMappingEntry } }. tenant_id optional defansif: body.tenant_id verildi ve JWT.TenantId ile farklı → 403 + INV-AUTH-010 (AuthCrossTenantBlocked, iter 2 fix dedicated forbidden code; INV-AUTH-003=AuthUnauthorized=401 semantic 403'e uymadı). TenantFieldMappingValidator.Validate çağrılır → fail → 400 + INV-BE-09x error code. Pass → repository.UpsertFieldMappingAsync. PUT sonrası resolver.Invalidate(tenantId) — ITenantFieldMappingResolver interface method (type-cast yok, DI decoration safe). Multi-instance not: Outbound/Automation instance'larındaki cache 5dk TTL ile eventual consistent (acceptable MVP). Success response envelope `{ data: {...} }` (DMP /api/v1/dynamic-fields pattern).

DI swap 3 servis (Backend/Program.cs:450, Outbound/Program.cs:90, Automation/Program.cs:97): NullTenantFieldMappingResolver yerine DbTenantFieldMappingResolver register. AddMemoryCache() + PostgresConnectionFactory dependency'leri zaten mevcut (Backend Program.cs:299, Automation TenantSettingsRepository pattern). Outbound için AddMemoryCache() yoktu → eklendi. NullTenantFieldMappingResolver dosyası SİLİNMEZ — test fixture + ileride per-tenant disable senaryosu için kalır (intentional). ITenantFieldMappingResolver interface'e Invalidate(int) method eklendi (Null=no-op, Db=cache.Remove); cache invalidation contract type-cast yerine interface method ile garanti edilir (DI decoration safe).

FEAT-DMP backward-compat: Tenant mapping kaydetmemişse veya placeholder mapping'de yoksa resolver null döner → DMP DynamicMessageValidator raw INMA key allowlist fallback'ine düşer (mevcut davranış, kırılma yok). Mapping yazan tenant semantic placeholder ({{roadshow_city}}) kullanmaya başlar → resolver cf1'e çevirir → INMA'ya cf1 gider.

tracking/feat-tfm-mvp.md yeni paket dosyası (status, AC checklist, deliverables). tracking/README.md master tablo update (FEAT-TFM-MVP satırı). arch/features/tenant-field-mapping.md status DRAFT → IN_PROGRESS (MVP scope clarification + out-of-scope note). arch/codex-context.md güncellemesi: 'DbTenantFieldMappingResolver null return = INTENTIONAL DMP raw INMA key fallback contract, bug değil' notu (Codex false-positive önleme).
Build PASS: Shared + Backend + Outbound + Automation. 0 warning (Codex CQ4 gate). Migration 028 idempotent re-run guvenli.

Microservice isolation korunur: DbTenantFieldMappingResolver Shared'da yaşar, 3 servis kendi PostgresConnectionFactory'sini inject eder. Servisler arası direct reference yok (Outbound → Backend HTTP yok, sadece kendi DB read). Service-isolation-checker agent'ı Shared değişiklikleri için manuel çağrılabilir (advisory).

CQ1.evidence: Endpoint catches return actionable codes/messages (401/400/403/500); resolver logs specific failures.

CQ2.evidence: Null-on-miss intentional contract; failures logged; OperationCanceledException rethrow.

CQ3.evidence: Diff matches plan.allowed_files; no scope creep.

CQ4.evidence: Per-service repo pattern; shared validator/resolver centralized.

CQ5.evidence: Parameterized SQL; snake_case columns; RequireAuthorization route-level; no null-forgiving.

CQ6.evidence: IMemoryCache + single-flight + WaitAsync per-caller cancellation; await using disposal.

CQ8.evidence: Interface expansion (Invalidate) implemented by both Null+Db; DI swap 3 services; build PASS.

Q1.reasoning: Migration 028 idempotent IF NOT EXISTS; field_mapping JSONB DEFAULT '{}'; leads.custom_1..custom_10 TEXT NULL additive.

Q2.reasoning: Tenant-scoped writes only; cross-tenant body mismatch 403 + INV-AUTH-010; reserved guard + cf1..cf10 enforced; route-level .RequireAuthorization().

Q3.reasoning: Invalidate clears cache+inflight; CancellationToken.None inflight + per-caller WaitAsync(ct) cancellation poison fix.

Q4.reasoning: DbResolver null-on-miss = NullResolver semantic parity; malformed JSON 500 + INV-BE-096; DB fail INV-BE-110; OCE 3-yer typed catch; SnakeCaseJson contract.
